description: This file defines the `FactorAuthInterface` interface for authentication modules related to 'Factor Authentication' within the SuiteCRM project. It includes method signatures for showing token input, sending tokens, and validating token messages.

methods.name: showTokenInput
methods.description: Method to display the token input interface, no parameters.

methods.name: sendToken
methods.description: Method to send the provided token, accepts a token parameter.

methods.name: validateTokenMessage
methods.description: Method to validate the token message, no parameters.
